memories.content: The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 climate conference and aims to produce a consolidated draft agreement text for negotiation. They have been working on drafts and are aware of the need to circulate a text before the final scheduled day of the summit.

COP21 is the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference held in Paris. The summit is scheduled to run from November 30 to December 11, 2015. The French Presidency is tasked with facilitating negotiations and producing a draft agreement text. The final scheduled day of the summit is December 11, 2015.
